name: Shijian 24
location_str: LC-9 @ Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
destination_explanation: Usually 600 to 800 km up and running nearly pole to pole, this is the favorite orbit for weather, mapping and Earth-imaging satellites.
slot_a_text: Experimental Chinese satellite of unknown purposes.
slot_b_text: A sun-synchronous orbit is tilted so the satellite crosses the equator at the same local time on every pass. Shadows fall the same way in every image, which is why almost all Earth-observation satellites use it.
